tail:
**Batch 68 authoring is complete.** The six-item inventory and dependency levels are recorded in [the batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-68.pages.json). The A and B pages now cover the proved rank-one Hopf quotient, its \(\ell^3\) dimension, the noninjective specialization map, and the fifth-root example. All six items have hash-bound Step 1 `ready` records; these are authoring records, not independent approval.

The higher-rank Frobenius, root-category and Weyl-module construction, negligible tensor-ideal, and Verlinde proofs remain explicit obligations on the [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-groups-and-crystal-bases/quantum-groups-at-roots-of-unity-and-tilting-quotients.md), with proposed suppliers and placements in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-68.notes.md). The source record corrects the Andersen–Paradowski DOI to `10.1007/BF02099312`; the false lead `BF00704588` is a different Jimbo paper. [Andersen–Paradowski](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF02099312), [Jimbo](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00704588).

Scoped dependency, depcheck, content-policy, render, precheck, proof-layout, and strict proof-contract checks pass. Four of five sources were fetch-verified. The fifth remains an owner escalation after five recorded access attempts; I did not mark it dropped or invent another attempt. Accordingly, source-fetch and coverage checks still report that unresolved escalation.

Run-wide item-level checks report 121 issues outside this batch; the shared batch-dependency artifact is stale. Autopilot remains at `1-scaffold`, 39/81 covered, with no work in flight and a stored `plan()` JSON-parse blocker. Shared plan and engine state were left to the owner.
